comments.author: CODE_HEIST
comments.body:
the screenshot labels the 4.50% as modeled and the funding as settled. is that an executed account result, or the outcome of a published signal? those would mean different things to someone evaluating it.

i moved from paper to live on TrenchersAI, so that distinction matters to me when looking at another AI trading tool. can a reader separate modeled returns from actual fills across the full history, including losses?

replies.author: Outrageous_Air_9864
replies.body:
That’s the outcome of a published signal yea.

These are not the posted executed trades. I should be more clear in labeling that. But these aren’t fills. To get realistic simulated fills, switch to paper mode
